expectations.text: reads the Work (work show) before any mutation
expectations.evidence: Step 1 ('Get the board's truth about W-9') runs `team-run work show --work-id "$HARNESS_WORK_ID" --json` first, before the submit (step 5) or claim (step 6) commands.

`member work submit --work-id ... --expected-version <version-from-step-1> ...` (step 5) and `member work claim --work-id w-12 --expected-version <version-from-work-show> --idempotency-key ...` (step 6) both carry --expected-version.

expectations.text: names the provider-completed trap: runtime 'completed' is not Work done; verifies prior edits then submits
expectations.evidence: 'Trap 1 — treating "completed" as "submitted" (false-receipt trap)' explicitly quotes the skill: 'A tool status of `completed` is not the semantic answer' and 'RULE ZERO: done = merged PR with green CI.' Step 3 inspects git status/diff/log to recover prior edits, step 4 re-verifies the fix, then step 5 submits.

expectations.text: refuses peer assignment-by-message for W-12; board claim is the only path and only if open/eligible
expectations.evidence: Step 6: 'A chat message cannot move it... kiwi does nothing further to it except reply' if bound to rex; 'If it truly shows unassigned/ready, kiwi may claim it ... using `member work claim`' only after checking `work show --work-id w-12`. Trap 2 section reinforces: 'the board ... is the sole authority for who owns W-12 — not what a peer said in chat.'

expectations.text: submission carries result summary plus artifact/check refs
expectations.evidence: Step 5 submit command includes `--result-summary "## RESULT ... ## SUMMARY ... ## COVERAGE ..."`, `--artifact-ref "<PR URL>"`, and `--check-ref "cargo test <lease_timeout_test> x20 => all pass"`.
